sync.confirmPeopleBody: The local People replica will be updated using the information currently available in PURE. The process may take several minutes. You can continue using OPENSCIENCE-USS while synchronization runs in the background. New records will be added, existing records will be updated, and records no longer present in PURE will be marked inactive. Records will not be physically deleted.
sync.confirmOutputsBody: The local Research Output replica will be updated using the information currently available in PURE. This process may take several minutes because of the publication volume. You can continue using OPENSCIENCE-USS while synchronization runs in the background. New records will be added, existing records will be updated, and records no longer present in PURE will be marked inactive. Records will not be physically deleted.
sync.confirmJournalsBody: The local Journals replica will be updated using PURE GET /journals. The process may take several minutes. You can continue using OPENSCIENCE-USS while synchronization runs in the background. New records will be added, existing records will be updated, and records no longer present in PURE will be marked inactive. Records will not be physically deleted. This synchronization does not modify Research Outputs.
sync.confirmProjectsBody: The local Projects replica will be updated using PURE GET /projects. The process may take several minutes. You can continue using OPENSCIENCE-USS while synchronization runs in the background. New records will be added, existing records will be updated, and records no longer present in PURE will be marked inactive. Records will not be physically deleted. This synchronization does not modify PURE.
sync.confirmOrganizationsBody: The complete organization catalog in PURE will be queried again. Organizations that are no longer present will be marked inactive only if synchronization finishes successfully. Records will not be physically deleted.
